groups.defect: Delegating CombinedRule abilities to a hook that hard-codes isFederated=false removes the immutability guard for federated Mimir groups.
groups.rationale: All three report the same lost federation check in the same ability path. Preserving the federation state resolves all three.

groups.defect: The undefined-rule skipToken path enables the Grafana Duplicate ability, which can incorrectly enable Duplicate for cloud rules.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same undefined-rule handling and its propagation through AlertRuleMenu's OR operation. A guard disabling abilities when no rule exists resolves both.
